notes: geoms: mjv_updateScene's list for eye_left; cameras.<name>.geom_differences lists the geoms whose pos differs for that camera (planes of size 0, recentred on the camera); every other field is equal across the five cameras (checked here)
lights: per camera, since light 0 is the headlight at the camera (mjv_makeLights)
feature_ablations: mean absolute difference per channel between the classic render with one feature off and the full classic render, 8-bit steps (0 = identical, 255 = opposite)
